neighbours.label: ' stay' (and similar self-care verbs) in public-health advice to the sick: 'stay home', 'keep yourself healthy'
fire: If you develop a fever or cough, please stay home from work until you recover.
Doctors advise that children with the flu stay home for at least a day after the fever ends.
When you feel sick, stay home and avoid contact with other people.
Anyone showing symptoms should stay indoors and call their doctor.
To prevent spreading the virus, sick employees must stay away from the office.
Health officials urge people with colds to stay home and rest.
If your child has a stomach bug, keep them home and let them stay in bed.
During flu season, stay home when ill and wash your hands often.
quiet: If you develop a fever or cough, please call your doctor before going to work.
Doctors advise that children with the flu drink plenty of fluids after the fever ends.
When you feel sick, take your temperature and write down your symptoms.
Anyone showing symptoms should book a test and call their doctor.
To prevent spreading the virus, sick employees must wear a mask in the office.
Health officials urge people with colds to drink tea and rest.
If your child has a stomach bug, give them water and plain crackers.
During flu season, get vaccinated early and wash your hands often.

notes: Card: top example ' stay' in 'If you are sick with flu-like illness, stay home'; also 'Keep yourself healthy', 'stay in jail'.
